RIENSANG-PRESCRIPT_DEVICE.title: Prescript: [Device]
RIENSANG-PRESCRIPT_DEVICE.description:
Gain [gold]Mark of the Prescript[/gold] and [gold]Wound-casing Mask[/gold]. 
Each turn: Mark [blue]1[/blue] random enemy with [gold]The Prescript's Target[/gold].
RIENSANG-ORACLES_PRESCRIPT.title: Oracle's Prescript
RIENSANG-ORACLES_PRESCRIPT.description:
Gain [gold]Mark of the Prescript[/gold] and [gold]Wound-casing Mask[/gold]. 
Each turn: Mark [blue]1[/blue] random enemy with [gold]The Prescript's Target[/gold]. 
Increased the number of [gold]Marked[/gold] cards to [blue]3[/blue] each turn and decreased [gold]Karmic Consequence[/gold] Penalty. 
[gold]The Prescript's Target[/gold] now receives 10% damage instead.
RIENSANG-SOMEONES_DEVICE.title: Someone's Device
RIENSANG-SOMEONES_DEVICE.description: If an enemy with [gold]The Prescript’s Target[/gold] is hit, inflict [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Sinking Count[/gold] to the enemy with [gold]The Prescript’s Target[/gold] next turn.
RIENSANG-PROVIDENCE_OF_THE_PRESCRIPT.des: Gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Poise Potency[/gold] or [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poise Count[/gold] at the start of each turn. Starting turn [blue]4[/blue], increase Poise's [gold]Crit Damage[/gold] by 15%.
RIENSANG-OMNITOOL.title: Omni-tool
RIENSANG-OMNITOOL.description: When the same damage type ([gold]Slash/Pierce/Blunt[/gold]) hits an enemy [blue]5[/blue] times. Inflict that damage type’s [gold]Fragility[/gold] at the start of each turn (3 Max).
